text:
jen: Heads-up: PM sync just flagged our milestone as tight. Two things: tenant routing still risky, embeddings cache shows regressions. Need a compact carve.
omar: Agree. What's the minimum for a customer pilot?
jen: Minimal: hosted API, basic auth, model catalog, SSO for pilot partners behind a flag, observability. No tenant-routing or on-prem.
tess: SSO toggle is doable with low infra touch. Tenant routing requires billing & infra work.
kai: Cache regression looks like a precision drift on long-tail queries and ~10% token cost bump. Ops recommends holding cache until fix.
jen: Proposal: Ship MVP without the new cache, enable SSO by feature-flag for partner pilots only, move tenant-routing and on-prem to v1.
omar: Launch acceptance checklist?
tess: 1) SSO end-to-end with partner accounts 2) Billing export sanity 3) Perf smoke p95 < 350ms 4) Security sign-off.
kai: Action: Eng to post a 1-page cutlist + risk matrix by EOD tomorrow. Include worst-case cost delta if cache disabled.
jen: Decision rule: If cache fix not validated in staging by Tue 12pm, ship without cache and schedule a 2-week follow-up.
ops-bot: Created ticket https://redwood.internal/tickets/1797773000-mvp-cutlist assigned to eng-core.
jen: Thanks. I'll update roadmap slice and notify execs. Recheck Mon 9am unless anything changes.
